title: Truck delivery: how servers get in
alt: A section through a loading bay and a data centre. A box truck backs into the covered bay up to the raised dock; boxes move into a staging room; a person rolls a rack along a corridor into the data hall. On the roof, an air intake louvre stands well back from the dock.
sources: kit3d SPEC rack: Vertiv VR3300, 600 x 1200 x 2000 mm
register arch_nbc6329: NBC 2020 Div. B 6.3.2.9.(2), Table 6.3.2.9: truck loading area or dock 7.6 m from air intakes
register arch_dc_rooms: storage and staging room (no size)

steps.caption: The truck backs up to the dock.
The boxes go into a staging room to be unpacked and checked.
Then the racks roll in to the data hall.
The air intakes sit at least 7.6 m from the truck dock.

camera: face-on section; follows the truck in, the boxes, then the rack to the hall, then pulls back
